notes: Counting convention decided from the page's own highlighting: the page highlights the segment 9504 in DM 9504 3801. Under character counting that segment is exactly year 95 + week 04 (1995, week 4). Under digit-only counting the date digits would be 0438 (year 2004, week 38), which is not the highlighted segment, so character counting is shipped and digit-only counting is not treated as a live alternative.

styles.notes: Page positions 3rd & 4th = year, 5th & 6th = week (1-based), applied as character positions [2,4] and [4,6] on the normalized serial; see file notes for why the highlighted 9504 segment supports character counting over digit-only counting.
